display_name: Stapleton-Viaux exponential response with combined-max coupling
description: SV_exp with the multiplicative coupling replaced by K_coup*<a*(I4-C1)+b*(I6-C2)>_+^zeta. All other terms are inherited unchanged.

parameters.name: mu
parameters.description: Linear coefficient for the first fiber family.

parameters.name: mu2
parameters.description: Linear coefficient for the second fiber family.

parameters.name: K_1ani1
parameters.description: I4 exponential-response coefficient for the first fiber family.

parameters.name: beta_1
parameters.description: I4 exponential-response rate parameter for the first fiber family.

parameters.name: K_1ani2
parameters.description: I6 exponential-response coefficient for the second fiber family.

parameters.name: gamma_1
parameters.description: I6 exponential-response rate parameter for the second fiber family.

parameters.name: K_coup
parameters.description: Amplitude of the convex combined-max coupling between the two fiber families.

parameters.name: zeta
parameters.description: Exponent of the convex combined-max coupling.

parameters.name: C1
parameters.description: Activation threshold for the first fiber family.

parameters.name: C2
parameters.description: Activation threshold for the second fiber family.

parameters.name: theta1
parameters.description: Reference angle of the first fiber family.

parameters.name: theta2
parameters.description: Reference angle of the second fiber family.

parameters.name: mu3
parameters.description: Linear coupling coefficient between the two fiber families.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: Weight of I4-C1 inside the combined coupling activation argument.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Weight of I6-C2 inside the combined coupling activation argument.
